country_rules.main_value_prop: We fill open roles with a shortlist of vetted candidates, so hiring managers spend their time on interviews instead of sourcing.
country_rules.secondary_value_prop: One recruiter owns each role from brief to signed offer and reports progress every week.
required_elements: say that timing depends on the role and the market
one clear call to action: a 20-minute call
country_rules.cta: Would you have 20 minutes this week or next for a quick call?

country_rules.main_value_prop: Every candidate on the shortlist is screened for skills and fit before the hiring manager sees them.
country_rules.secondary_value_prop: HR gets fewer, better interviews instead of an inbox full of CVs.
required_elements: lead with the quality of the candidates, not with speed
one clear call to action: a short call
country_rules.cta: Do you have 20 minutes this week or next to walk through it together?

country_rules.main_value_prop: We take sourcing and first-round screening off the HR team, so they can focus on onboarding and the people already there.
country_rules.secondary_value_prop: Clear weekly updates per role, so nobody has to chase the status.
required_elements: mention that the process depends on the seniority of the role
one clear call to action: a short call
country_rules.cta: Would you be available for a short 20-minute call this week or next?

country_rules.main_value_prop: We present the company to candidates in a clear and consistent way, which helps when hiring in a competitive market.
country_rules.secondary_value_prop: One partner for several open roles instead of separate agencies.
banned_claims: superlatives such as the best or number one
required_elements: keep claims general, because hiring markets differ by country
one clear call to action: a short call
country_rules.cta: Do you have 20 minutes this week or next for a short conversation?
